ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given, as shown in the figure, $AB \parallel CD$, $\angle ABE = 80^\circ$, $EF$ bisects $\angle BEC$, $EF \perp EG$, find the degree measure of $\angle DEG$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $AB\parallel CD$, $\angle ABE=80^\circ$,\\
thus, $\angle BEC=180^\circ-\angle ABE=100^\circ$,\\
since EF bisects $\angle BEC$,\\
thus, $\angle CEF= \frac{1}{2} \angle BEC=50^\circ$,\\
since $EF\perp EG$,\\
thus, $\angle FEG=90^\circ$,\\
hence, $\angle DEG=180^\circ-\angle CEF-\angle FEG=\boxed{40^\circ}$

Reasoning: From the given conditions, AB ∥ CD, and ∠ABE = 80°. BE intersects the two parallel lines, so the same-side interior angles ∠ABE and ∠BEC are supplementary; therefore ∠BEC = 180° - 80° = 100°. EF bisects ∠BEC, so ∠CEF = 100° ÷ 2 = 50°.
